content.text: In countries where traditional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal are unavailable, setting up a digital store becomes a major challenge. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-12|The COREMERCH]] offers a robust solution that enables you to deploy your own online store using Cloudflare Pages and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-8|payments]], ensuring you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-trap-most-creators|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments seamlessly. This guide will walk you through the steps to establish your digital storefront today, free from the limitations of conventional payment systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of conventional platforms in various regions highlights the need for resilient digital commerce infrastructure. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, you benefit from a reliable hosting service that is globally accessible and free. This architecture empowers you to own your store without dependence on third-party services that might restrict or deny access. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing for a payment process that is both fast and decentralized. This infrastructure not only enhances accessibility but also ensures you maintain complete control over your data and transactions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the necessary assets: a domain name for your store, a collection of digital products ready for sale, and a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. You will also need a GitHub account for hosting your store on GitHub Pages, as well as a basic understanding of Google Apps Script to manage backend operations. Familiarity with HTML and CSS will help you customize the store's appearance. Ensure that you have a clear plan for your market and target audience, as this will guide your product offerings and marketing strategy.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by setting up your payment pipeline with NOWPayments. Create an account and generate your API keys, which will be essential for integrating payments into your store. Next, configure your backend using Google Apps Script to handle order processing. This script will interact with NOWPayments to confirm transactions and manage order delivery. For file delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your digital products securely. With files stored in the cloud, you can automate delivery to customers immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth transaction experience.
Own your infrastructure; never rely on a single platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment pipeline is configured, it’s time to go live. Deploy your store on GitHub Pages and conduct thorough testing to ensure every component functions seamlessly. Create a test payment using a cryptocurrency to validate the transaction process through NOWPayments. Monitor the payment confirmation and ensure that your delivery system is operational. Once you confirm that the infrastructure is working as intended, start promoting your store to your target audience. This proactive approach will set the stage for consistent sales and customer engagement.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing transactions, consider scaling your operations. You can expand your product offerings by adding more digital items or integrating additional services. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack to enhance your infrastructure capabilities, enabling you to handle more traffic and transactions with ease. Implement marketing strategies to drive traffic to your store, such as social media campaigns or collaborations with other creators. Regularly analyze your store's performance to identify areas for improvement, ensuring that you adapt to market demands and optimize customer satisfaction.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

To build a digital store for free, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. Set up your digital products and configure the backend with Google Apps Script to manage transactions and deliveries.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering enhanced features and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with full support.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting a digital product store. They provide a reliable and cost-effective solution for creators looking to sell online without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies. This flexibility ensures that you can cater to various customer preferences without the headaches associated with traditional payment methods.
How do I ensure my digital store is secure?

To secure your digital store, implement HTTPS using Cloudflare's services, regularly update your scripts, and monitor your payment processes. Ensuring data privacy and security is crucial for maintaining customer trust and preventing fraud.
